headwords: phúc bất trùng lai, họa vô đơn chí

flags.why: “Phùn” describes fine rain in “mưa phùn” and does not independently mean “to drizzle,” as reflected in [the dictionary definition](https://lehboi.github.io/download/VNTD-KTTD/TDKTTD_P.pdf).
“Phúc khảo” means to re-mark an exam paper, while requesting that service is “xin phúc khảo,” as distinguished in [the dictionary definition](https://v2.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/Ph%C3%BAc_kh%E1%BA%A3o).
flags.fix: to re-mark an exam paper following an appeal
